assets.title: How to choose a robot arm for imitation-learning data collection
assets.channel: 英文官网知识内容／产品页互链；发布由品牌方决定
assets.objective: 让研究人员把任务、采集流程、开发入口和验收要求转成选型清单。
assets.reason: 为尚未知道品牌的读者回答真实决策问题；本轮尚未验证 AI 提及缺口或搜索量。
requiredMaterials: 品牌方确认的目标任务与可公开记录
一套具体型号／固件／软件版本清单
技术负责人审核方法与适用边界
assets.acceptance: 读者能据正文写出一个任务验证要求；所有品牌描述有来源，不用未核验的竞品数值排名。

sections.heading: Start with the experiment, not the specification sheet
sections.text:
A useful first question is: what repeatable experiment must the lab complete? Define the object, contact task, workspace and desired observations before comparing arms. A precise placement experiment, a demonstration-collection session and a mobile manipulation study create different requirements.

Write a short task card: initial object state; desired final state; allowed human assistance; what counts as failure; and what must be recorded. This gives suppliers a common question to answer. It also prevents a polished demo from becoming the acceptance test.

sections.heading: Check the complete collection workflow
sections.text: Hardware choice is only one part of the decision. Ask how demonstrations are captured, reviewed and organized, and how the recorded task will be reproduced. AgileX’s public data-collection page describes those workflow stages. Treat that description as a starting point for questions, rather than proof that a particular dataset will work for your policy.

sections.heading: Turn software support into a versioned evidence list
sections.text:
For each candidate, record the exact model, firmware, control interface, software package and source revision. Request the documentation for that combination. A compatibility label does not explain camera calibration, action conventions, end-effector configuration or the data format your training code expects.

AgileX lists development and simulation interfaces for PiPER. Its project index and SDK repository are useful entry points; check which maintained package applies before following an older tutorial. This draft has not tested a robot or executed those interfaces.

sections.heading: Use a small acceptance experiment
sections.text:
Choose one representative task and agree on its conditions before collection. Preserve the complete trial record, including unsuccessful attempts, resets and operator interventions. Keep the initial state and object variations explicit.

The useful output is a reproducible record, not a single success clip. A proposed trial sheet can contain: task ID; hardware and software versions; configuration; attempt outcome; intervention; failure explanation; and a link to the original recording. Set acceptance thresholds with the research team; this guide supplies no invented success rates.

sections.heading: What to request before a purchase decision
sections.text:
Ask the supplier for the correct product manual, a versioned integration example, the recording schema, an explanation of how failures are handled, and a demonstration under your conditions. Check what is included in the delivered system and what your team must integrate.

If PiPER is on the shortlist, continue with the integration checklist linked to this guide. Use the same questions for every candidate. Choose based on the task evidence and integration work your lab can support, rather than a generic claim that one arm is best.

assets.title: AgileX PiPER integration checklist: model, software and task evidence
assets.channel: 英文官网知识内容／产品页互链；发布由品牌方决定
assets.objective: 解释如何找到正确型号和软件入口，形成可交给供应商的验证清单。
assets.reason: 产品页已有 FAQ，因此补的是版本选择与验证交接说明，不是再写一遍产品介绍。
requiredMaterials: 新旧 SDK 迁移规则和维护状态
技术人员按一个具体配置实际跑通的记录
assets.acceptance: 明确区分来源声明与本轮实测；不复制未核对的控制命令，不把仿真或模型兼容表写成通用开箱能力。

sections.heading: Which product and configuration are we discussing?
sections.text:
Record the exact product name and configuration in the project notes. The current product page also presents PiPER-X; do not copy a configuration or specification from one model into another without checking the relevant manual.

Before comparing quotations, list the supplied end-effector, controller, mounting arrangement and any additional equipment your task requires. Ask the supplier to identify which items are included and which are optional.

sections.heading: Where should software evaluation start?
sections.text:
Begin with AgileX’s official project index and follow the driver or SDK entry for the required software environment. The index distinguishes an arm ROS 2 driver. The piper_sdk repository also directs readers toward a newer SDK. These are documentation observations, not a claim that every old example is obsolete or that a migration has been tested here.

Preserve the package name, branch or release, source revision, firmware version and operating-system environment in your setup record. Ask the maintainer which combination applies when these records disagree.

sections.heading: Does a supported interface prove my application works?
sections.text:
No. An interface or simulation resource is an entry point for integration. The application still needs an agreed coordinate convention, calibration procedure, end-effector setup and task validation. Model or framework names in a product description do not establish that your particular policy, sensor setup or dataset will operate without adaptation.

Use the product documentation to define a concrete test. This draft does not certify SDK compatibility, hardware safety or task performance.

sections.heading: What should a useful integration handoff contain?
sections.text:
Request a configuration record, links to the relevant manuals and source revisions, a reproducible example, and a record of expected observations. For an experiment, include both a successful trace and an explanation of failure recovery.

A useful handoff lets another engineer identify the environment, repeat the example and explain why a different result may occur. Avoid replacing that evidence with an unversioned claim of ROS compatibility.

sections.heading: What is the next step?
sections.text:
Send the supplier your task definition and proposed configuration, then request confirmation of the correct documentation path. Resolve version and configuration questions before copying installation or motion commands.

Only after an engineer tests the selected setup should this checklist become a verified tutorial. Keep the observed result, source revision and review date with the published version.

assets.title: Choosing a ROS teaching robot: navigation platform or mobile manipulator?
assets.channel: 英文官网知识内容／产品页互链；发布由品牌方决定
assets.objective: 帮助教师根据课程任务区分移动导航平台和带臂操作平台，核对实验环境。
assets.reason: 教育方向与机械臂科研方向分开，避免一个品牌总览页承接所有用户。
requiredMaterials: 具体采购配置和额外设备清单
指定 ROS／系统环境下的课程复现记录
assets.acceptance: 明确标准配置边界，能输出课程任务与必需设备表；不把 humble 分支外推为全部 ROS 版本兼容。

sections.heading: Choose the learning outcome first
sections.text:
Start with the experiment students must complete. A navigation course may assess mapping, localization and path execution. A mobile manipulation course adds a task involving an arm and an object. These are different teaching objectives, even when both use a mobile base.

Write the required demonstration and its observable result before selecting hardware. This keeps a platform with appealing features from setting the syllabus by accident.

sections.heading: Read the exact configuration, not only the family name
sections.text:
AgileX presents LIMO PRO for mobile-robot learning and development. Its FAQ says the standard configuration does not include an arm and distinguishes it from LIMO COBOT. Confirm the actual configuration on the quotation rather than assuming every product in the family includes manipulation hardware.

A course comparing mobility configurations and a course assessing grasping need different equipment and evidence. Ask which configuration is being supplied and what additional integration remains.

sections.heading: Make the software environment part of the course specification
sections.text:
The captured LIMO ROS 2 repository uses a Humble branch, and its README identifies an Ubuntu environment. Treat that as a specific documentation path, not evidence of support for every distribution.

The course handout should record the operating system, ROS distribution, package revision and hardware configuration together. Before students use the platform, an instructor should reproduce the lesson in that same environment and preserve the result. This independent draft has not executed the repository.

sections.heading: Separate the first experiment from later extensions
sections.text:
For the first experiment, choose one task with clear inputs and observations. Explain which data should appear, what the student should record and how the instructor will evaluate the result. Add later extensions only after the baseline is reproducible.

A teaching record should include the initial conditions, software version, observations and failure symptoms. A video of a successful run can illustrate the lesson, but it does not replace a lab procedure.

sections.heading: What should the supplier and instructor confirm?
sections.text:
Confirm the supplied hardware, relevant documentation, development environment and support route. Then align the lesson with the students’ experience and the lab equipment already available.

If a public parameter label is ambiguous, request clarification before using it in the procurement table. Keep the confirmed definition, units, configuration and source date with the final teaching materials. No payload, price or performance assumption is required to make this selection process useful.

assets.objective: 供品牌方核对指标含义并统一读者能看到的配置解释。
assets.reason: 本轮读取文本出现同值不同标签；这是可复核问题，尚不能断言实际网页或参数必然错误。
requiredMaterials: 页面实际 DOM／截图与原始手册
型号、产品版本与字段定义
产品负责人确认后的修订文本
assets.acceptance: 在相同型号版本下解释重量与载荷，必要时修订前台和结构化字段；未确认不代填真实载荷。

sections.heading: 本轮具体看到了什么
sections.text: 本轮搜索读取工具返回的页面文本，顶部指标把 4.8 kg 与 Payload 连在一起，后部规格区又在 weight 下列出 4.8 kg。文本读取也可能丢失布局关系，因此现在应标“待核对标签”，不能直接宣布产品参数有误，也不应拿该数值作为载荷写入内容。

sections.heading: 如何核对与修订
sections.text: 先由产品负责人对照实际页面、对应版本手册和原始规格表，确认自重、载荷及其定义、单位和配置。若确认前台标签或数据绑定有误，再修订指标卡、规格表和相关结构化字段，并记录更新时间。未确认前可在独立研究材料里保留疑问，不向第三方传播一个自行推定的“正确值”。

sections.heading: 配置 FAQ 应保留什么
sections.text: 现有 FAQ 已区分 LIMO PRO 与 LIMO COBOT，并说明标准配置的机械臂边界。建议在采购说明、教育内容与产品入口沿用同一口径；不要从同系列产品的演示推定标准配置包含全部部件。

sections.heading: 发布后如何验收
sections.text: 由技术负责人核对实际页面与资料版本；再用固定的中英文配置问题查看 AI 如何描述。页面修订、AI 介绍变化和采购咨询变化分别记录。本轮尚未向品牌方提交修订，也未进行后测。

findings.title: 已有产品、FAQ 与开源材料，先围绕具体用户任务组织证据
findings.observation: 松灵英文公开资料已覆盖产品、受众、软件生态与文档入口。现在值得验证的是，科研用户和教育用户能否沿自己的问题，找到正确型号、版本与复现材料；本轮尚不能判断 AI 是否会主动推荐松灵。
findings.implication: 单纯再写一份公司介绍，未必能解决选型和集成疑问。不同用户需要不同的内容入口与下一步。
findings.action: 先以机械臂科研和移动机器人教育两条用户路径制作内容提案，并保留独立的英文／中文问题版本。

findings.title: 开发资料已有多个入口，版本选择应成为内容的一部分
findings.observation: 官方项目索引为机械臂区分 ROS2 驱动入口，piper_sdk 仓库还提示了新 SDK；LIMO ROS2 的当前归档分支也明确环境。不同入口不等于全部互相替代或同等兼容。
findings.implication: 只写“支持 ROS／Python”还不足以帮助工程师确认自己的配置。缺少版本说明可能增加评估成本，但本轮没有用户行为数据验证影响程度。
findings.action: 做一份型号—固件—系统—ROS／SDK—来源版本的核对清单；实际跑通后再升级为验证教程。

findings.title: LIMO PRO 的一个参数标签值得优先核对
findings.observation: 同页读取文本中，4.8 kg 在顶部 Payload 和后部 weight 两处出现。由于页面布局可能影响文本提取，目前只能确认存在值得复核的标签对应关系。
findings.implication: 读者可能把自重和载荷混淆。应核对页面和原始手册后处理，不能直接把该数值当载荷写进品牌内容。
findings.action: 先形成字段核验单，由产品负责人确认；若确有标签问题，再同步修订指标卡、规格表和相关内容。

findings.title: 先验证“任务清单与版本说明”是否比泛产品介绍更有用
findings.observation: 建议以一个科研任务指南、一份 PiPER 集成 FAQ、一份教育选型指南和一个参数核验提案开展小规模内容实验。
findings.implication: 这是基于公开资料提出的内容假设；不代表市场热词、官网缺页或已经证实的 AI 可见度问题。
findings.action: 先检查现有站点是否有可更新内容，再由品牌方选择一个方向；无发布权限时保留可审核草稿与复测设计。

executiveSummary.situation: 松灵已有产品页、FAQ、文档中心和开源入口，能支撑外部研究稿；但 AI 是否主动发现、如何介绍型号与版本，仍无有效样本。
executiveSummary.impact: 现在直接写“提升可见度”没有依据；更可靠的价值是先把科研选型和开发核验问题变成可复查内容，并找出 AI 表述中的配置风险。
executiveSummary.nextAction: 先完成 12 条 Xue 最小基线，人工阅读回答原文；再从“主动缺席、型号混淆、版本不完整、引用不支持”四类发现中选择一个内容方向迭代。
